m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: What's this? Did that prissy Duke Dairyus dare to betray us? I knew it! The modern House Purrzian is an embarrassment to our legacy!
Let us destroy the Duke and every other living member of House Purrzian. They've brought it upon themselves. First though, these interlopers.
I wonder why Overlord Xerxes would send his Durvishes here. Surely it's not the Chronoshard. It has no value to anyone outside the Rift.
The Chronoshard is just a collection of sand grains, crystallized moments in the history of Mirage, specifically, those related to our House.
It'll show whether my claim or Crowl's is stronger, but that's all. Maybe there's something else down here of value? I wonder. Let's go.
What now? Treasure hunters seeking to loot this place? Poor wretches - these antiquities belong to Overlord Xerxes now, in his brilliance.
Few realize, the key to controlling a world is first to control its history. It's how we conquered Mirage before, and how we'll do so again.
Of course, we must destroy all who stand against us, both on the battlefield and off. I think we'll make an example of you. Yes.
I must confess, hearing the Overlord's strategy, I am both impressed and horrified. It's very smart... diabolical even.
Hello. I know Cosrow didn't let you waltz in here, so you must have defeated him. Ah, you're the Wizard the Overlord warned us about.
Yes, I believe he has special plans for you... but what are you doing here? The Chronoshard? That old thing? Why? It's worthless.
I would simply give it to you, but my orders are to bring back everything to the Overlord. In fact, perhaps I'll bring you back as well...
It's clear the threat posed by Overlord Xerxes is all too real. House Tabbi certainly has an interest in joining this alliance of yours, Wizard.
First, however, we must settle the question of succession. Let's get the Chronoshard and return to the Manor.
See? They've returned - just as the Reverend Mother assured us. Place the Chronoshard on the Stand and then let us discuss what we must do next.
Well done. This will undoubtedly silence those who still have doubts about Atraydies' qualifications.
Wait... this isn't even about our claim to the lordship and our bid to take the Manor? Hmmph! Fine, then I won't bother to recall my Assailants!
That's fine. Right now, we have simply come to collect our House Chronoshard.
Oh, you want YOUR Chronoshard, Tabbi? Must I remind you that the Agouti Chronoshard is shared between our Houses? It's as much ours as it is yours!
Yes, I'm aware it's my duty to share it, but... well, no one's needed it for decades! We... we left it in the ruins of our ancestral home.
In the Buried Gardens? You must be joking!
We Purrzians never joke, Tabbi. It's beneath us. The Chronoshard is indeed in the Buried Gardens, along with a squad of Xerxes' Durvishes.
I suppose you've heard about our... miscalculation in resurrecting the traitor, Xerxes. He's sent his men here to collect Purrzian antiquities.
They demanded exclusive access to the Buried Gardens, but I owe them nothing. You'll have to fight them, but you won't hear me crying. Go on.
That traitorous dog, Xerxes... I'd like to claw his eyes out. Of course, I don't like you either, so you two fighting each other makes me happy.
